suppress.notes: CVE-2026-47883: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo does not register UrlHandlerFilter or broad redirect filter patterns. EventController and PersonController expose explicit /api/events and /api/people routes. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47883/

CVE-2026-47884: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo uses RestController methods that serialize DTOs, pages, IDs, or void. It has no XsltView configuration or catch-all mapping that renders an inferred view. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47884/

CVE-2026-47885: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo uses servlet Spring MVC with Tomcat, without Spring WebFlux. It has no PartEventHttpMessageReader or RequestBody Flux<PartEvent> endpoint. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47885/

CVE-2026-47886: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo does not parse or evaluate user-supplied SpEL expressions. Request parameters are scalar values or Pageable, not expression source. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47886/

CVE-2026-47887: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo does not configure UrlFileNameViewController or infer view names from request paths; its RestController methods serialize response bodies. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47887/
CVE-2026-47888: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo has no RSocket dependency, server, or SETUP frame handler. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47888/

CVE-2026-47889: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo uses servlet Spring MVC with embedded Tomcat, not WebFlux with the Jetty 12 Core reactive adapter required by this issue. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47889/

CVE-2026-47890: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo returns ordinary response bodies; it has no SSE endpoints, view fragments, SseEmitter, or reactive streaming views. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47890/

CVE-2026-47891: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo does not use Spring WebFlux or the Aalto XML processor to read XML request bodies; controllers accept scalar request parameters. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47891/

CVE-2026-47892: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo uses annotated servlet MVC controllers, without WebFlux functional endpoints or header predicates on a WebFlux-to-DispatcherServlet bridge. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47892/

CVE-2026-47893: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo does not use Spring WebFlux or register WebSocket endpoints. Tomcat's transitive websocket JAR does not configure a WebFlux endpoint. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47893/

CVE-2026-59280: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo has no FreeMarker dependency, SpringTemplateLoader, or template views. Its controllers return response bodies rather than user-derived view names. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59280/

CVE-2026-59281: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo does not obtain HTML-escaped Errors objects or render field errors through getFieldError()/getFieldErrors(); its endpoints return response bodies. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59281/

CVE-2026-59282: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo does not bind request property paths onto objects with self-populating List properties. Controllers accept scalar parameters and Pageable; Event and Person relationships use HashSet, and response DTOs are not binding targets. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59282/

CVE-2026-59283: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo does not create SimpleEvaluationContext or a compiled SpEL parser, and its configuration does not enable IMMEDIATE or MIXED SpEL compilation. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59283/

CVE-2026-59313: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo has no MVC functional RouterFunction or ServerResponse.sse() endpoint. Its annotated controllers return ordinary response bodies without SSE streams. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59313/

CVE-2026-59314: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo does not construct Content-Disposition headers from user input or build outbound multipart requests; it uses the supported Tomcat connector. Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-59314/

CVE-2026-47834: not applicable to the current Coherence Hibernate demo. The demo's Pageable inputs are passed to JpaRepository.findAll(), not native SQL. EventRepository's only Query is fixed JPQL and accepts an event ID, without Sort or Pageable. Neither repository declares NativeQuery or Query(nativeQuery=true). Advisory: https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47834/
